card.name: And inside 'Dosage and Administration' references
card.fires_on: The word 'and' in the cross-reference '[see Dosage and Administration (2.x)]' in drug labels. A few web-text cases also fire on 'the', an apostrophe or 'change' in short phrases.

modes.label: Dosage and Administration cross-reference
modes.description: The word 'and' between 'Dosage' and 'Administration' inside a bracketed section reference.

modes.label: Scattered web-text cases
modes.description: A small word or apostrophe in general web text, such as 'the' after 'change' or an apostrophe after 'engines'.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly Chinese and rare pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the word 'and' in the label cross-reference 'see Dosage and Administration'.
